APPLICATION PLANNING

Recommended Uses

10 L ice bucket

Backyard BBQ ↗

A 10 L acrylic bucket sized for ice and bottles: A full bag of ice goes in with room to spare.

Outdoor Bars ↗

You can see how many are left without digging.

Yacht Parties ↗

Guests help themselves instead of flagging a server.

Confirm for your project

Check table layout, how many rounds it serves and washing conditions；service speed, stacking storage and lighting after dark；deck grip, how stable the shape is and the operator's container rules.

These are selection suggestions. Review the chosen configuration and sample against your intended use.
